name: smwgraphics-snes-controller-buttons
title: SNES Controller Buttons
description:
Originally made and submitted (and rejected) on the Summer C3 of 2023. This submission was a suggestion / request by
Heitor Porfirio.
It has since been refined and greatly improved thanks to the feedback received.

This is a pack of graphic tiles for each and every button on a SNES / Super Famicom controller.
They're intended to be used in tutorial levels, or as general indicators of what input is expected from the player at any point in a level.

There are a few alternate designs for most buttons to suit different needs and preferences, including different colors and button formats.
There are also animated versions of all tiles to show the button being pressed.

The graphics use a handful of palette rows to accomodate for all different colors of buttons, but only uses the right side of them, so the only palettes overwritten are Pink Berry and Red Berry.
Depending on your needs, you may not use all palettes.

The included ReadMe file contains information on the usage of palettes, as well as the use of slots for ExAnimation, so it's worth checking out if you need to change these things for any reason (such as palette space, AN2 file space, ExAnimation slots...).
